$comment: Maps source path globs to the spec file that owns them. scripts/check-drift.mjs uses this (in CI PR context only) to require a spec diff whenever owned code changes. Globs are checked in listed order; a path may match more than one entry. Entries are deliberately file-level (not a package-wide `**`) for packages/engine-api and packages/contract-tests, so that e.g. editing render-host.ts requires only specs/render-host.md to change, not specs/engine-api.md too. The UX-freeze (U4) entries below are package-wide `**` on purpose: packages/app is a catch-all for editor UI not owned by a canvas-specific package (scene tree, viewport, inspector, data tab, pointer picker, and Copilot panel all live there until/unless they earn their own package), and packages/graph-canvas / packages/audio-canvas / packages/script-panel are not yet scaffolded, added now so ownership governs them from the moment they exist (same rationale as packages/editor-core below).
